title: Connectivities for k-knitted graphs and for minimal counterexamples to Hadwiger's Conjecture
summary: For a given subset $S\subseteq V(G)$ of a graph $G$, the pair $(G,S)$ is \emph{knitted} if for every partition of $S$ into non-empty subsets $S_1, S_2, \ldots, S_t$, there exist pairwise disjoint connected subgraphs $C_1, C_2, \ldots, C_t$ in $G$ such that $S_i\subseteq V(C_i)$ for all $1 \le i \le t$. A graph $G$ is \emph{$\ell$-knitted} if $(G,S)$ is knitted for every subset $S\subseteq V(G)$ of size $\ell$. In this paper, we prove that every $8\ell$-connected graph is $\ell$-knitted.
